_comment: Engines: 'edge' (edge-tts neural voices), 'melo' (MeloTTS local neural Korean voice, one female voice, runs offline in .venv-tts) or 'say' (macOS built-in voices, offline fallback). 'auto' tries edge, then melo, then say. Every word/sentence is generated in EVERY voice listed for the engine; the app then picks one at random per play (Settings → Voice). Dialogue lines use the voice matching the speaker's gender. Changing voices/rate and re-running `npm run build-audio` regenerates only what changed.
